Title: Verify Date Picker 1 (mm/dd/yyyy) selects a date from the calendar popup
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Steps: 1. Click the 'Date Picker 1' field 2. Verify the calendar popup opens 3. Click day 15 in the calendar 4. Read the field value
Expected Result: Field shows the date in mm/dd/yyyy format with day 15

Title: Verify Date Picker 2 (dd/mm/yyyy) selects a date using the month and year dropdowns
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Steps: 1. Click the 'Date Picker 2' field 2. Select month 'Mar' from the month dropdown 3. Select year '2025' from the year dropdown 4. Click day 10 5. Read the field value

Title: Verify Date Picker 3 calculates the number of days for a valid date range
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Steps: 1. Enter Start Date 2. Enter End Date after the start date 3. Click Submit 4. Read the result message
Expected Result: Message 'You selected a range of 30 days.' is displayed

Title: Verify Date Picker 3 rejects an end date earlier than the start date
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Steps: 1. Enter Start Date 2. Enter an End Date earlier than the start date 3. Click Submit 4. Read the result message
Expected Result: Validation message 'End date must be after start date.' is displayed

Title: Verify Date Picker 3 requires both dates before submitting
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Steps: 1. Leave Start Date and End Date empty 2. Click Submit 3. Read the result message
Expected Result: Message 'Please select both start and end dates.' is displayed
